description: This is a Java test class for the WizardPagesAdapter component in the Android application, using Robolectric for unit testing. It tests the behavior of the adapter with different Android SDK versions and verifies the number of pages and fragment types created.

classes.name: WizardPagesAdapterTest
classes.description: A test class for the WizardPagesAdapter, verifying its behavior across different Android SDK versions.

methods.name: testHasPermissionsPageForAndroidM
methods.description: Tests that the adapter correctly includes a permissions page and language pack page when running on Android M.

methods.name: testNoPermissionsPageBeforeAndroidM
methods.description: Tests that the adapter does not include a permissions page when running on Android Lollipop.
